back: The book of prime entry listing credit sales of goods from copies of sales invoices. Also called the sales day book.
The book of prime entry listing credit purchases of goods for resale from suppliers' invoices. Also called the purchases day book.
A reduction in the list price for trade customers, deducted on the invoice. It is never entered in the ledger.
Debit each customer with their invoice; credit the sales account with the period total.
Credit each supplier with their invoice; debit the purchases account with the period total.

front: Where does a credit purchase of equipment go?
back: In the general journal, not the purchases journal (purchases = goods for resale).
In the cash book. The sales journal is for credit sales only.
List price − trade discount, e.g. US\$2,000 less 10% = US\$1,800.
It groups credit sales so only one total is posted to the sales account, keeps the ledger tidy and shows credit sales for the period.
